summary: Replaces an earlier launcher (NoConsoleLauncher.cs, deleted) that used .NET's ProcessStartInfo.CreateNoWindow and produced an inconclusive A/B (no flash in either branch, since CreateNoWindow leaves a hidden-but-attached console that a grandchild process just reuses). This launcher calls Win32 CreateProcess directly with the real DETACHED_PROCESS flag (0x00000008), giving the launched node.exe genuinely no console object at all — the actual condition an Electron app's (Claude Code/Cursor) hooks/*.mjs child process runs under. Verified on real Windows 11 hardware: unpatched shows a new console window, patched shows nothing, confirmed by both the automated IsWindowVisible poll and direct visual observation.
